text:
maddie: LAN at the office this Friday? I can bring my desktop (RTX 3080), Switch dock, and a couple of surge strips. Also have 2 spare Steam keys (Overcooked 2, Hotline Miami) to gift. Who's up for a chill evening? :party-parrot:
ryan: i'm in. can bring a couple of chairs and my switch pro controller. what time?
caroline: projector? i can bring it — would save people from huddling around laptops. :projector:
harpreet: 7pm start works for me, need to head out by 11 though. can we do rotation for matches?
leo: i'll bring 10ft ethernet and a small switch so we can LAN proper. also have an extra Xbox controller.
noah: tempted. can i sign up for one of those steam keys? Overcooked would be brilliant. :yum:
maddie: @noah yep i'll DM the keys. quick note: please bring power strips (no daisy-chaining) and label chargers. office circuits are picky.
sam: if people want, i can throw together a tiny bracket for a Mario Kart 8 tourney. 3 races per match, losers rotate.
caroline: love that. can we also have a cozy couch area for Smash? fewer cables, more snacks.
harpreet: snack sign-up? i'm bringing chips, unless someone is allergic to gluten (please call it out).
leo: bringing surge-protected strip and a box of ethernet ties. also a tiny handheld for retro warmups (microconsole).
infra-bot: Heads up: visitor wifi requires registration at the front desk after 6pm. If you're bringing non-employee guests, please ping people-ops.
maddie: noted infra-bot — thx. can we do a quick poll on turnout? react with :one: for "just watching", :two: for "playing", :three: for "bringing gear"
ryan: :two:
caroline: :three:
harpreet: :two:
leo: :three:
noah: :one:
sam: :three:
maddie: Looks like we've got a healthy mix. i'll post a final RSVP thread tomorrow with setup slots and a small list of what to bring (HDMI, controllers, surge strips). If anyone wants a steam key, DM me now. No pirated copies please :grimacing:
ryan: should we do a tiny prize? like a $15 steam gift card for the tourney winner?
caroline: yes please. i'll chip in a fiver.
maddie: sweet — i'll cover the rest. see y'all Friday! :tada:
